title: Toolshop account access: cases that pass against the product (login form, invalid login, wrong current password, successful change)

scenarios.title: Login form shows email and password fields

steps.action: Open the login page (#/auth/login) as an anonymous visitor
expected: The login form shows an email field
The login form shows a password field

externalReferences.system: upstream user story v5: User Login

scenarios.title: Invalid credentials show "Invalid email or password"

steps.action: Register a new customer account through the API (disposable account owned by this case)
Open the login page and sign in with that account's email and a wrong password
expected: The error "Invalid email or password" is shown

externalReferences.system: upstream user story v5: User Login

scenarios.title: Wrong current password is rejected with its message

steps.action: Register a new customer account through the API and sign in with it
On the profile page, enter a wrong current password and a valid new password with a matching confirmation, then submit the change password form
expected: The error "Your current password does not matches with the password." is shown

externalReferences.system: upstream user story v5: Change Password

scenarios.title: Successful change confirms and logs out after 5s

steps.action: Register a new customer account through the API and sign in with it
On the profile page, enter the current password and a valid new password with a matching confirmation, then submit the change password form
expected: The user is logged out after about 5 seconds

externalReferences.system: upstream user story v5: Change Password
